description: Get Governance Risk Scores (GRS) for NZX companies. 0-100 scale across 6 components: exec remuneration, board structure, shareholder rights, board effectiveness, audit & risk, remuneration disclosure. Can filter by sector, rating, or score range.

rating.description: Filter by rating: Excellent, Very Good, Good, Adequate, Poor, Very Poor

name: get_governance_scores

data.description: The tool payload. Null when the call did not produce one — read meta.availability_status to find out why, and do not treat null as zero, empty or "none found".

availability_status.description: ok: complete payload. truncated: payload exceeded the transport cap and was cut. parse_failed: payload is text this server could not parse as JSON. error: the tool raised.

encoding.description: toon = pipe-delimited tabular encoding; header row names the columns.

provenance.description: Whether the figures can cite a source document. "direct": every returned row carries its own document URL (see meta.sources). "reachable": some do, or the documents sit beside figures that are not rows. "undeclared": no document URL was found in this payload — it is not a claim that the data is unsourced.

retrieved_at.description: When this platform produced the answer — NOT the as-at date of the data.

sources.description: Primary documents (NZX announcements, annual reports) whose URLs appear in this payload. Cite these with their date when you quote a figure. A listed document was returned with the data; it is not proof that a given sentence of your answer came from it.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, or null when the row has no date.

schema_version.description: Envelope contract version. Bumps only on a breaking shape change.
